claimedSlice: opencv2/datasets/*.hpp parser-backed public header closure; OpenCV 5.0.0 has no datasets umbrella header and all caller-data loaders remain evidence-only
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact Datasets wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The datasets module consumes caller-provided dataset files, directory trees, annotations, and file paths; this package bundles no dataset assets or datasets native/managed wrapper.
